question: Which three recipient addresses received the largest summed Transfer value from 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 on chain 1 in the pinned inclusive window?

definitions.window: Use the exact quoted fromBlock through toBlock, both inclusive. Do not substitute a moving latest block.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.

definitions.metric: log-rank: key to, sum value in raw token units. Exclude recipient 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000. Include transfers regardless of sender. Keep only positive totals.
